name: @gala-chain/gala-mcp-server

tools.name: gala_create_wallet
tools.description: Create a new wallet with a random private key. Returns wallet address and private key. ⚠️ SECURITY: Store the private key securely immediately — it cannot be retrieved again and grants full access to the wallet.

tools.name: gala_create_solana_wallet
tools.description: Create a new Solana wallet with a random keypair. Returns wallet address and private key (base58 format). ⚠️ SECURITY: Store the private key securely immediately — it cannot be retrieved again and grants full access to the wallet.

tools.name: gala_get_address
tools.description: Get the GalaChain address format (eth|...) for the authenticated wallet.

tools.name: gala_get_ethereum_address
tools.description: Get the standard Ethereum address format (0x...) for the authenticated wallet.

tools.name: gala_get_public_key_from_private_key
tools.description: Derive public key from private key using secp256k1. Returns uncompressed (0x04..., 132 chars) and compressed (0x02/03..., 68 chars) formats.

tools.name: gala_get_ethereum_address_from_private_key
tools.description: Derive Ethereum address from private key. Returns both Ethereum (0x...) and GalaChain (eth|...) address formats.

tools.name: gala_get_version
tools.description: Get SDK and MCP server version information. Returns both versions which are dynamically read from package.json files.

tools.name: gala_has_wallet
tools.description: Check if wallet is configured in the SDK. Returns true if wallet is available for signing operations, false if in read-only mode.

tools.name: gala_get_wallet
tools.description: Get the wallet instance currently configured in the SDK. Returns wallet object if available, or null if in read-only mode.

tools.name: gala_set_wallet
tools.description: Configure a wallet for signing operations. Takes a private key and sets it as the active wallet.

privateKey.description: Private key (0x prefixed hexadecimal string) to configure as the active wallet.

tools.name: gala_get_environment
tools.description: Get the current environment (`prod` or `stage`) that the MCP server is using.

tools.name: gala_switch_environment
tools.description: Dynamically switch the MCP server to `prod` or `stage`. Preserves wallet configuration when switching.

tools.name: gala_fetch_gala_balance
tools.description: Get GALA balance for a wallet.

address.description: Wallet address (optional, defaults to SDK wallet). Forms: client|<id>, eth|<address>, 0x<address> or the 40 hex digits (eth|0x<address> is not a valid form); a mixed-case address must be its exact EIP-55 checksum, and an Ethereum account is sent to GalaChain as eth|<EIP-55>.

tools.name: gala_transfer_gala
tools.description: Transfer GALA tokens via GalaChain.

recipientAddress.description: Recipient wallet address. Forms: client|<id>, eth|<address>, 0x<address> or the 40 hex digits (eth|0x<address> is not a valid form); a mixed-case address must be its exact EIP-55 checksum, and an Ethereum account is sent to GalaChain as eth|<EIP-55>.

amount.description: Amount in standard decimal format (e.g., "1" for 1 GALA)

privateKey.description: Optional private key override for this operation (format: "0x" + 64 hex characters). If provided, uses this wallet instead of the default MCP server wallet.

tools.name: gala_estimate_bridge_fee
tools.description: Estimate bridge fees for transferring tokens between GalaChain and an external chain. Returns fee amount in source token (the fee does not depend on the amount bridged).

tokenId.description: Token identifier in flexible format (string or object).

tools.name: gala_bridge_out
tools.description: Bridge tokens from GalaChain to an external chain (Ethereum or Solana). Requires wallet configuration.

tokenId.description: Token identifier in flexible format (string or object).

amount.description: Amount to bridge.

recipientAddress.description: Recipient address on the destination chain (Ethereum: 0x... format, Solana: base58 format).

tools.name: gala_bridge_in
tools.description: Bridge tokens from an external chain (Ethereum or Solana) to GalaChain. Requires wallet configuration.

tokenId.description: Token identifier in flexible format (string or object).

amount.description: Amount to bridge.

tools.name: gala_get_bridge_status
tools.description: Get the status of a bridge transaction by transaction hash. Returns status (pending/confirmed/failed), block number, and error details if applicable.

transactionHash.description: Transaction hash from bridgeOut or bridgeIn operation (either chain).

tools.name: gala_get_supported_bridge_tokens
tools.description: Get list of tokens supported for bridging, optionally filtered by chain. Returns token details including decimals, supported chains, and contract addresses.

tools.name: gala_is_token_bridgeable_to_solana

tokenId.description: Token identifier in flexible format (string or object).

tools.name: gala_request_solana_devnet_airdrop
tools.description: Request SOL airdrop from Solana devnet faucet. Only available in STAGE environment (development/testing). Maximum 2 SOL per request. Useful for funding wallets with gas fees for testing bridge operations.

amount.description: Amount of SOL to request (default: 1, range: 0.001-2).

address.description: Optional Solana address to receive airdrop (defaults to configured wallet).

tools.name: gala_get_solana_transaction_status
tools.description: Get the status of a Solana transaction by signature. Queries Solana RPC directly using getSignatureStatuses (no WebSocket required). Use this to verify if an airdrop or bridge transaction succeeded after submission. Returns: { confirmed: boolean, status: "confirmed"|"finalized"|"processed"|"not_found"|"failed", slot?: number, error?: string }. Requires solanaPrivateKey configuration.

signature.description: Base58-encoded Solana transaction signature (87-88 characters). Get this from requestSolanaDevnetAirdrop or bridge operations.

tools.name: gala_get_ethereum_transaction_status
tools.description: Get the status of an Ethereum transaction by hash. Queries Ethereum RPC directly using getTransactionReceipt and getTransaction (no WebSocket required). Use this to verify if a bridge transaction succeeded after submission. Returns: { confirmed: boolean, status: "pending"|"confirmed"|"finalized"|"not_found"|"failed", blockNumber?: number, confirmations?: number, gasUsed?: string, effectiveGasPrice?: string, error?: string }. Uses 12+ confirmations as finality threshold. Requires ethereumPrivateKey configuration.

transactionHash.description: Ethereum transaction hash (0x-prefixed 64-character hex string, 66 total characters). Get this from bridgeOut or bridgeIn operations.

tools.name: gala_fetch_all_wrappable_tokens

tokenId.description: Token identifier in flexible format. Pipe-delimited: "$MUSIC|Unit|none|none" or TokenClassKey object: { collection, category, type, additionalKey }

tokenId.description: Token identifier in flexible format. Pipe-delimited: "$MUSIC|Unit|none|none" or TokenClassKey object: { collection, category, type, additionalKey }

tools.name: gala_wrap_token
tools.description: Wrap a token to its asset-channel counterpart (e.g., MUSIC → GMUSIC). This is a cross-channel bridge within GalaChain, NOT an external bridge to Ethereum/Solana. Requires wallet configuration. Use for tokens that need to be wrapped before DEX trading.

tools.name: gala_unwrap_token

amount.description: Amount to wrap/unwrap (decimal string, e.g., "100.5").

tools.description: Estimate fees for wrapping a token to the asset channel. Wrap operations use cross_channel_authorization fee type on the source channel.

amount.description: Amount to wrap for fee estimation.

tokenId.description: Token to unwrap, by class key (e.g., "$GMUSIC|Unit|none|none"; a bare symbol is refused).

amount.description: Amount to unwrap for fee estimation.

tools.name: gala_fetch_pool_details_for_calculation
tools.description:
Get optimized pool details for local bonding curve calculations.

Returns only essential calculation parameters:
- currentSupply: Current token supply (computed with full precision)
- remainingTokens: Tokens available for purchase
- maxSupply: Maximum token supply
- reverseBondingCurveMaxFeeFactor: Maximum reverse bonding curve fee (normalized to number)
- reverseBondingCurveMinFeeFactor: Minimum reverse bonding curve fee (normalized to number)
- reverseBondingCurveNetFeeFactor: Net fee factor (max - min, for convenience)

This is more efficient than fetchPoolDetails as it returns only fields needed for calculations.
Perfect for use with calculateBuyAmountLocal and calculateSellAmountLocal.

- Analyze token details before trading

**Flexible Token Identification:**
Supports both pipe-delimited string and object formats for maximum flexibility.

tools.name: gala_resolve_vault_address
tools.description:
**DO NOT GUESS** - Resolve a launchpad token name to its GalaChain vault address.

The vault address format is NOT derivable from the token name. You MUST use this tool.

Results are cached for performance - subsequent calls are instant.

tools.name: gala_resolve_token_class_key
tools.description:
**MANDATORY** - Convert a launchpad token name to its GalaChain TokenClassKey.

⚠️ DO NOT GUESS OR CONSTRUCT TokenClassKey FROM TOKEN NAME!

The relationship is NOT predictable:
- Token "anime" might have type "ANM", not "ANIME"
- Token "dragon" might have type "DRG", not "DRAGON"
- The additionalKey contains creator's ETH address (IMPOSSIBLE to guess)

ALWAYS use this tool before any operation requiring TokenClassKey.
Results are cached - subsequent calls are instant.

tools.name: gala_on_pool_updated
tools.description:
Watch for pool metadata updates in real-time.

Triggers when pool metadata, social links, or badges are updated. Includes:
- POOL_METADATA_UPDATED: Name, description, image, category changes
- POOL_SOCIAL_LINKS_UPDATED: Website, Discord, Twitter, etc. changes
- POOL_BADGE_ASSIGNED: New badges or badge assignments

Returns:
- poolsUpdated: Number of pool updates detected
- updates: Array of pool update events with tokenName, updateType, and metadata changes

Filter Options:
- tokenName: REQUIRED. Pool updates are watched per-token; there is no way to watch every token at once.
- updateType: Filter by type ('METADATA', 'SOCIAL_LINKS', or 'BADGE_ASSIGNED').

durationSeconds.description: How long to watch for new events in seconds (default: 60).

tools.name: gala_get_pool_realtime_state
tools.description:
Get a combined real-time snapshot of a pool.

Fetches, in parallel, from real underlying endpoints:
- holderCount: current holder count and total balance
- chatConfig: chat/comments enabled status (chatEnabled, commentsEnabled)
- recentTrades: the 10 most recent trades
- price: current token spot price

There is no single backend endpoint for this - each field is fetched independently. A field
that fails on its own is returned as null with a <field>Error message rather than failing
the whole call. There is no platform data for stream status (ACTIVE/IDLE/DISABLED) as a
standalone concept, or an active-moderators summary - use
gala_get_active_moderators separately for that.

RETURNS: { tokenName, holderCount, chatConfig, recentTrades, price } (each nullable, with an
optional <field>Error string if that one fetch failed).

tokenName.description: The token name to get state for.

tools.name: gala_on_holder_count_changed

Watch for token holder count changes in real-time.

Triggers whenever the holder count for a token changes, including:
- New holders making their first purchase
- Holders liquidating their entire position
- Changes in holder distribution and tiers

Returns:
- holdersChanged: Number of holder count change events detected
- events: Array of holder count events with tokenName, newCount, previousCount, and timestamp

Filter Options:
- tokenName: REQUIRED. Holder-count changes are watched per-token; there is no way to watch every token at once.
- minThreshold: Only notify if holder count changes by >= minThreshold.

tokenName.description: Watch holder changes for this token (required).

minThreshold.description: Only notify if holder count changes by at least this amount (optional).

durationSeconds.description: How long to watch for new events in seconds (default: 60).

tools.name: gala_calculate_buy_amount
tools.description:
Calculate token amounts for buying with fee breakdown.

PARAMETERS:
- type: 'native' (spend GALA) or 'exact' (buy token amount)
- amount: Spend amount (native) or token quantity (exact)

RETURNS:
- amount: Exact token amount to receive
- transactionFee: Launchpad transaction fee (GALA)
- gasFee: Fixed gas fee ('1' GALA)
- reverseBondingCurveFee: Dynamic pool fee (min-max range).

amount.description: Amount in standard decimal format (e.g., "1" for 1 GALA).

type.description:
Trade calculation type:

- 'native': You specify GALA amount to spend
  Example: "I want to spend 10 GALA to buy tokens" -> type: 'native', amount: '10'

- 'exact': You specify exact token amount to buy
  Example: "I want to buy exactly 1000 WOO tokens" -> type: 'exact', amount: '1000'

Most common: Use 'native' when you know how much GALA to spend.

tools.name: gala_calculate_sell_amount
tools.description:
Calculate GALA amounts for selling tokens.

PARAMETERS:
- type: 'native' (receive GALA amount) or 'exact' (sell token amount)
- amount: GALA desired (native) or tokens to sell (exact)

RETURNS:
- amount: GALA received (type 'exact') or tokens to sell (type 'native')
- transactionFee: Launchpad transaction fee (GALA)
- gasFee: Fixed gas fee ('1' GALA)
- reverseBondingCurveFee: Dynamic pool fee applied to the sale (what sell() allows, plus slippage).

amount.description: Amount in standard decimal format (e.g., "1" for 1 GALA)

type.description:
Trade calculation type:

- 'native': You specify GALA amount you want to receive
  Example: "I want to receive 10 GALA from selling tokens" -> type: 'native', amount: '10'

- 'exact': You specify exact token amount to sell
  Example: "I want to sell exactly 1000 WOO tokens" -> type: 'exact', amount: '1000'

Most common: Use 'native' when you know how much GALA you want to receive.

tools.name: gala_buy
tools.description:
Execute token purchase with slippage protection.

WORKFLOW:
1. calculateBuyAmount() -> Get expected output (result.amount)
2. buy() -> Execute trade with expectedAmount (buys pay no reverse bonding curve fee)
3. fetchTrades() -> Verify trade completed

- result.amount -> expectedAmount
- maxAcceptableReverseBondingCurveFee is optional for a buy.

RETURNS: Transaction details including input/output amounts and transaction ID.

amount.description: Amount to spend/buy.

type.description:
Trade type (must match what you used in calculateBuyAmount):

- 'native': Spending GALA amount
- 'exact': Buying exact token amount.

maxAcceptableReverseBondingCurveFee.description: OPTIONAL: Base reverse bonding curve fee from calculateBuyAmount (GALA), result.reverseBondingCurveFee. Buys pay no reverse bonding curve fee, so this can be omitted.

maxAcceptableReverseBondingCurveFeeSlipp.description: Optional slippage tolerance for reverse bonding curve fee (decimal, e.g., 0.01 for 1%). Defaults to 0.01 (1%) if not provided. Applied to maxAcceptableReverseBondingCurveFee to increase max acceptable fee.

privateKey.description: Optional private key override for this operation (format: "0x" + 64 hex characters). If provided, uses this wallet instead of the default MCP server wallet.

tools.name: gala_sell
tools.description:
Execute token sale with slippage protection.

WORKFLOW:
1. calculateSellAmount() -> Get expected output (result.amount and result.reverseBondingCurveFee)
2. sell() -> Execute trade with expectedAmount (and optionally maxAcceptableReverseBondingCurveFee)
3. fetchTrades() -> Verify trade completed

- result.amount -> expectedAmount
- result.reverseBondingCurveFee -> maxAcceptableReverseBondingCurveFee (optional: when omitted the

tools.name: gala_stop_stream
tools.description:
Stop a live stream for a token.

Ends the current stream session. The stream key remains valid for future streams.

RETURNS: { success: true }

Authentication: Requires wallet signature (stream creator only)

tools.name: gala_set_stream_enabled
tools.description:
Enable or disable streaming for a specific token (Admin only).

Controls per-token streaming capability. When disabled, prevents new streams
from being started for this token. Existing active streams will continue
until they end.

RETURNS: { enabled, tokenName }

Authentication: Requires streamAdminApiKey configuration

enabled.description: Whether streaming should be enabled for this token.

tools.name: gala_reset_stream_key
tools.description:
Reset the stream key for a token.

Generates a new stream key, invalidating the previous one.
Use this if the stream key has been compromised.

RETURNS: { tokenName, streamKey, rtmpsUrl, srtUrl, srtPassphrase, playbackId, resetAt }

Authentication: Requires wallet signature (stream creator only)

tools.name: gala_set_next_live_stream_countdown
tools.description:
Set the next live stream countdown time for a token.

Schedules a future live stream for this token. The countdown can be displayed on the pool page
to let viewers know when the stream will go live.

Can be called multiple times to update the scheduled time.
Pass null as nextLiveStreamAt to clear the countdown.

RETURNS: { success: true, message: "..." }

Authentication: Requires wallet signature (stream creator only)

oneOf.description: ISO 8601 datetime for next live stream (e.g., "2025-01-15T18:00:00Z"). Pass null to clear countdown.
Pass null to clear the countdown.

nextLiveStreamAt.description: ISO 8601 datetime for next live stream or null to clear countdown.

tools.name: gala_get_global_streaming_status
tools.description:
Get global streaming status.

Returns platform-wide streaming status including maintenance windows.

RETURNS: { enabled, updatedAt }

Authentication: None required (public endpoint)

tools.name: gala_set_global_streaming_enabled
tools.description:
Enable or disable streaming globally (Admin only).

Controls platform-wide streaming capability.
When disabled, no new streams can be started.

RETURNS: { enabled, updatedAt }

Authentication: Requires streamAdminApiKey configuration

enabled.description: Whether streaming should be enabled globally.

tools.name: gala_get_stream_role
tools.description:
Get the authenticated user's role for a token's stream with associated permissions.

Returns effective role (OWNER, MANAGER, TECHNICAL_PRODUCER, MODERATOR) with boolean permission flags.
canStream: Can start/stop streams. canModerate: Can moderate chat/ban. canManageTeam: Can manage moderator invites.

RETURNS: { role: 'OWNER'|'MANAGER'|'TECHNICAL_PRODUCER'|'MODERATOR'|null, isOwner, permissions: { canStream, canModerate, canManageTeam, canViewRecordings, canSimulcast }, source, inviteScope }

Authentication: Optional JWT - returns limited data if not authenticated

tools.name: gala_get_available_roles
tools.description:
Get all available roles and permissions for token delegation.

Returns reference data about the role system, including:
- All available roles (OWNER, MANAGER, TECHNICAL_PRODUCER, MODERATOR)
- Role descriptions and hierarchy levels
- Permissions assigned to each role
- Complete list of all available permissions

**Role Hierarchy (highest to lowest):**
- OWNER (level 3): Full access to all token operations
- MANAGER (level 2): Full moderator + tech producer + recordings + settings
- TECHNICAL_PRODUCER (level 1): Stream setup and management
- MODERATOR (level 0): Community and chat management

**Available Permissions:**
- MANAGE_COMMENTS: Create/delete comments
- MANAGE_CHAT: Send/delete chat messages
- BAN_USERS: Ban users from token streams
- UNBAN_USERS: Remove bans from users
- MANAGE_SIMULCAST: Add/remove simulcast targets
- GET_STREAM_KEY: View the stream key
- STOP_STREAM: Stop an active stream
- RESET_STREAM_KEY: Generate a new stream key
- START_STREAM: Start a new stream
- DELETE_RECORDINGS: Delete stream recordings
- MANAGE_STREAM_SETTINGS: Update stream settings (countdown, language)

This is static reference data - it doesn't change per user or token.
Useful for building role selection UIs and understanding permission hierarchies.

RETURNS: { roles: [...], permissions: [...] }

Authentication: None required (public endpoint)

tools.name: gala_get_token_access
tools.description:
Check if the authenticated user has Studio access for a token.

Returns comprehensive access information combining:
1. Token ownership check (OWNER role)
2. Claimed moderator invite (MANAGER, TECHNICAL_PRODUCER, MODERATOR)
3. Platform overseer status (global access)

This is used by frontends to determine whether to show "Click to Studio" links.

**Access Sources:**
- ownership: User is the token owner (OWNER role)
- moderator_invite: User has a claimed moderator invite
- overseer: User has platform-wide overseer access

**Permissions Returned:**
- canStream: Can start/stop streams
- canModerate: Can moderate chat and ban users
- canManageTeam: Can manage moderator invites
- canViewRecordings: Can view and download recordings
- canSimulcast: Can manage simulcast targets
- canViewAnalytics: Can view stream analytics

RETURNS: {
  hasAccess: boolean,
  role: 'OWNER' | 'MANAGER' | 'TECHNICAL_PRODUCER' | 'MODERATOR' | 'OVERSEER' | null,
  permissions: { canStream, canModerate, canManageTeam, canViewRecordings, canSimulcast, canViewAnalytics },
  accessSource: 'ownership' | 'moderator_invite' | 'overseer' | null,
  inviteScope?: 'TOKEN' | 'ALL_OWNER_TOKENS' | null,
  isOwner: boolean,
  isOverseer: boolean
}

Authentication: Optional JWT - returns limited data if not authenticated

tools.name: gala_get_stream_recordings
tools.description:
Get recordings for a stream.

Returns paginated list of available recordings from past streams using cursor-based pagination.

RETURNS: { recordings: [...], tokenName, pageInfo: { hasNextPage, endCursor, hasPreviousPage, startCursor } }

Authentication: None required (public endpoint)

cursor.description: Cursor from previous response (omit for first page).

tools.name: gala_get_recording_download
tools.description:
Get a signed download URL for a recording.

Returns a time-limited URL for downloading the recording file.

RETURNS: { downloadUrl, expiresAt, assetId, fileName }

Authentication: Requires wallet signature (stream creator only)

tools.name: gala_delete_recording
tools.description:
Delete a stream recording.

Permanently removes the recording. This action cannot be undone.

RETURNS: { success: true }

Authentication: Requires wallet signature (stream creator only)

tools.name: gala_get_simulcast_targets
tools.description:
Get simulcast targets for a stream.

Returns list of configured simulcast destinations with platform, rtmpUrl, and status for each target.

RETURNS: { targets: [{ targetId, platform, rtmpUrl, status, name, createdAt }, ...], tokenName, maxTargets }

Authentication: None required (public endpoint)

tools.name: gala_add_simulcast_target
tools.description:
Add a simulcast target to a stream.

Configure the stream to rebroadcast to an external platform like YouTube, Twitch, or Facebook.

RETURNS: { target: { targetId, platform, rtmpUrl, status, name, createdAt }, tokenName }

Authentication: Requires wallet signature (stream creator only)

platform.description: Simulcast platform (YOUTUBE, TWITCH, FACEBOOK, or CUSTOM).

streamKey.description: Stream key for the simulcast target.

name.description: Optional display name for the simulcast target.

tools.name: gala_remove_simulcast_target
tools.description:
Remove a simulcast target from a stream.

Stops rebroadcasting to the specified platform.

RETURNS: { success: true }

Authentication: Requires wallet signature (stream creator only)

tools.name: gala_get_chat_status
tools.description:
Get chat status for a stream.

There is no standalone chat-status endpoint - this reads chatEnabled/commentsEnabled from
the token's general configuration record (the same record setChatEnabled() writes).

RETURNS: { chatEnabled, commentsEnabled, ...other config fields }

Authentication: None required (public endpoint)

tools.name: gala_set_chat_enabled
tools.description:
Enable or disable chat for a specific token.

Dual-auth endpoint - supports both Admin API key and JWT (owner) auth.

**Authorization:**
- Admin (API key): Sets ADMIN_DISABLED when disabling - owner is locked out
- Owner (JWT): Sets DISABLED when disabling - owner can re-enable later

When ADMIN_DISABLED, only an admin can enable chat.
Owners attempting to enable when ADMIN_DISABLED will get a 403 error.

RETURNS: { enabled, tokenName, status }

Authentication: Requires streamAdminApiKey (admin) OR JWT auth (token owner)

tools.name: gala_set_slow_mode
tools.description:
Set slow mode interval for a stream chat.

Slow mode throttles users to one message per N seconds.
Enforcement is server-side (Redis-backed rate limiting).
Setting to 0 disables slow mode.

Valid presets: 0 (off), 10, 30, 60, 300 seconds.
Maximum: 600 seconds (10 minutes).

RETURNS: { tokenName, slowModeSeconds }

Authentication: Requires streamAdminApiKey (admin) OR JWT auth (token owner/moderator)

slowModeSeconds.description: Slow mode interval in seconds (0 = disabled, max 600). Common values: 0, 10, 30, 60, 300.

tools.name: gala_connect_stream_websocket
tools.description:
Connect to the stream WebSocket server.

Establishes a WebSocket connection for real-time stream events.
Must be called before subscribing to streams or sending WebSocket chat.

Throws error if connection fails or if already connected. Check SDK state before calling.
This connection persists until explicitly disconnected or the SDK is cleaned up.
Use gala_disconnect_stream_websocket to close the connection.

RETURNS: { connected: true, message: 'Connected to stream WebSocket' }

Authentication: None required for connection (authentication needed for some operations).

tools.name: gala_subscribe_to_stream
tools.description:
Subscribe to a stream's real-time events.

Must be connected via gala_connect_stream_websocket first - throws error if not connected.
After subscribing, you will receive these events:
- stream_status: Live/offline status changes
- viewer_count: Real-time viewer count updates
- chat_message: New chat messages
- chat_status: Chat enable/disable events

RETURNS: { tokenName, status, playbackId, isLive, subscribedAt }

tools.name: gala_send_stream_chat_via_web_socket
tools.description:
Send a chat message via WebSocket.

Sends a message through the WebSocket connection (lower latency than REST).
Requires:
1. WebSocket connected via gala_connect_stream_websocket
2. Authenticated via wallet signature
3. Subscribed to the stream via gala_subscribe_to_stream

RETURNS: { sent: true, tokenName, content }

Authentication: Requires wallet signature via WebSocket authentication.

tools.name: gala_send_stream_reaction
tools.description:
Send an ephemeral emoji reaction to a live stream.

Reactions are broadcast to all viewers via WebSocket but NOT persisted to database.
Rate limiting is enforced server-side (burst of 10, then 0.5/sec refill).

Requires:
1. WebSocket connected via gala_connect_stream_websocket
2. Authenticated via wallet signature
3. Subscribed to the stream via gala_subscribe_to_stream

RETURNS: { sent: true, tokenName, emoji, streamTime }

Authentication: Requires wallet signature via WebSocket authentication.

emoji.description: Emoji to send (single emoji or short sequence, max 15 chars). Preset: heart, fire, rocket, gem, star.

streamTime.description: Current stream timecode in seconds (for viewer sync, defaults to 0).

tools.name: gala_send_typing_indicator
tools.description:
Send a typing indicator to a stream chat.

Indicates whether the authenticated user is currently typing.
Typing indicators are ephemeral (NOT persisted to database) and broadcast to all
users in the stream chat room except the sender.

The server auto-clears typing status after 5 seconds of inactivity.
Other users will see "X is typing...", "X and Y are typing...", or "Several people are typing...".

Requires:
1. WebSocket connected via gala_connect_stream_websocket
2. Authenticated via wallet signature
3. Subscribed to the stream via gala_subscribe_to_stream

RETURNS: { sent: true, tokenName, isTyping }

Authentication: Requires wallet signature via WebSocket authentication.

isTyping.description: Whether the user is currently typing (true = start typing, false = stop typing).

tools.name: gala_login
tools.description: Authenticate with wallet signature to get JWT token. Required before using protected features (streaming, chat, uploads). Returns expiresIn seconds; the token is managed internally and never returned via MCP.

tools.name: gala_logout
tools.description: Clear JWT token and end session. Future protected operations will fail until login() is called again.

tools.name: gala_refresh_token
tools.description: Refresh JWT token before it expires. Use shouldRefreshToken() to check if refresh is needed. Returns expiresIn seconds; the token is managed internally and never returned via MCP.

tools.name: gala_get_session
tools.description: Get current session information from backend. Returns authenticated address and token timestamps. Requires active session.

tools.name: gala_is_authenticated
tools.description: Check if user is authenticated with valid (non-expired) JWT token. Returns boolean.

tools.name: gala_should_refresh_token
tools.description: Check if JWT token should be refreshed (expires within threshold). Default threshold is 5 minutes. Returns boolean.

tools.name: gala_get_access_token
tools.description: Check whether an access token is available. Returns authenticated: true/false. Token values are never returned via MCP — use ensureValidToken() to validate.

tools.name: gala_ensure_valid_token
tools.description: Ensure valid token exists, refreshing if necessary. Call before long operations. Throws if not authenticated.

tools.name: gala_create_ban
tools.description:
Create a ban for a user on a token.

Bans prevent users from sending chat messages and reactions on the specified token's stream.
Can be permanent (omit durationSeconds) or temporary (specify duration).

**Duration Presets:**
- 1 hour: 3600
- 1 day: 86400
- 1 week: 604800
- 1 month: 2592000

RETURNS: { ban: { id, userAddress, tokenName, reason, bannedBy, expiresAt, createdAt, isPermanent }, tokenName }

Authentication: Requires streamAdminApiKey (admin) OR JWT auth (token owner).

userAddress.description: Wallet address of user to ban.

durationSeconds.description: Ban duration in seconds (optional, omit for permanent). Range: 60 (1 min) to 31536000 (1 year). Presets: 3600 (1 hour), 86400 (1 day), 604800 (1 week), 2592000 (1 month).

tools.name: gala_remove_ban
tools.description:
Remove a ban for a user on a token.

Unbans the user, allowing them to send chat messages and reactions again.

RETURNS: { removed: true, tokenName, userAddress }

Authentication: Requires streamAdminApiKey (admin) OR JWT auth (token owner).

userAddress.description: Wallet address of user to unban.

tools.name: gala_list_bans
tools.description:
List all banned users for a token.

Returns a paginated list of banned users with their ban details using cursor-based pagination.
Supports filtering by search query, name, or user address.

**Filter Behavior:**
- search: Combined search on userAddress OR fullName (partial match)
- name: Filter by fullName only
- userAddress: Filter by userAddress only

RETURNS: { bans: [...], pageInfo: { hasNextPage, endCursor, hasPreviousPage, startCursor } }

Authentication: Requires streamAdminApiKey (admin) OR JWT auth (token owner).

cursor.description: Cursor from previous response (omit for first page).

name.description: Filter by fullName only (case-insensitive, partial match).

userAddress.description: Filter by userAddress only (case-insensitive, partial match).

tools.name: gala_get_ban_status
tools.description:
Check if a specific user is banned on a token.

Returns whether the user is currently banned and ban details if applicable.

RETURNS: { banned: boolean, ban?: { ... }, tokenName, userAddress }

Authentication: Requires streamAdminApiKey (admin) OR JWT auth (token owner).

userAddress.description: Wallet address of user to check.

tools.name: gala_get_active_users
tools.description:
Get currently active users on a token's stream.

Returns up to 1000 active viewers or chat participants.
Useful for moderation - see who's watching/chatting before issuing bans.

**User Types:**
- viewers: All users currently connected to the stream
- chat_participants: Users who have sent chat messages

RETURNS: { tokenName, type, users: [...], total, truncated }

Authentication: Requires streamAdminApiKey (admin) OR JWT auth (token owner).

type.description: Type of active users to fetch (default: viewers).

name.description: Filter by fullName only (case-insensitive, partial match).

userAddress.description: Filter by userAddress only (case-insensitive, partial match).

tools.name: gala_on_ban_enforcement
tools.description:
Watch for user ban enforcement events in real-time.

Triggers when users are banned, unbanned, or ban enforcement actions are taken. Includes:
- USER_BANNED: User restricted from platform due to policy violation
- USER_UNBANNED: Ban lifted, user access restored
- BAN_ENFORCEMENT: Enforcement action taken (message deletion, chat suspension, etc.)

Returns:
- banActionsEnforced: Number of ban enforcement events detected
- events: Array of ban events with userAddress, actionType, reason, tokenName, and timestamp

Filter Options:
- userAddress: Only watch bans for a specific user
- actionType: Filter by action type ('BANNED', 'UNBANNED', or 'ENFORCEMENT')
- tokenName: Only watch bans related to a specific token
- reason: Filter by ban reason or violation type.

userAddress.description: Only watch bans for this user (optional).

tokenName.description: Filter bans for a specific token (optional).

durationSeconds.description: How long to watch for new events in seconds (default: 60).

tools.name: gala_create_api_key
tools.description:
Create a new API key for delegating permissions.

**CRITICAL**: The rawKey in the response is ONLY shown once!
Store it securely immediately - it cannot be retrieved again.

**Roles (hierarchical):**
- MODERATOR: Manage comments, chat, bans
- TECHNICAL_PRODUCER: Stream control, simulcast
- MANAGER: Moderator + Technical Producer + recordings
- OWNER: Full access

**Token Delegation:**
- delegateAllTokens=true: Access to all current and future tokens
- delegateAllTokens=false + tokenNames: Access to specific tokens only

RETURNS: { id, keyPrefix, rawKey, description, role, delegateAllTokens, tokenNames, expiresAt, createdAt, ... }

Authentication: Requires JWT auth (call sdk.login() first).

role.description:
API key role determining permissions:
- MODERATOR: Manage comments, chat messages, ban/unban users
- TECHNICAL_PRODUCER: Simulcast targets, stream key, stop/start stream
- MANAGER: Moderator + Technical Producer + recordings + stream settings
- OWNER: Full access (indistinguishable from normal auth).

description.description: User's description/label for this API key (max 255 characters)

delegateAllTokens.description: If true, key has access to ALL tokens owned by the user (current and future). If false, only tokens in tokenNames are accessible.

tokenNames.description: Specific tokens to delegate access to (ignored if delegateAllTokens is true). Token names are case-insensitive.

expiresAt.description: Optional expiration date in ISO 8601 format (e.g., "2025-12-31T23:59:59Z"). If not provided, never expires.

tools.name: gala_list_api_keys
tools.description:
List all API keys for the authenticated user.

Returns a paginated list of API keys using cursor-based pagination.
Raw keys are never included - they are only shown once at creation time.

RETURNS: { apiKeys: [...], pageInfo: { hasNextPage, endCursor, hasPreviousPage, startCursor } }

Authentication: Requires JWT auth (call sdk.login() first).

cursor.description: Cursor from previous response (omit for first page).

tools.name: gala_get_api_key
tools.description:
Get a single API key by ID.

Returns the API key metadata. Raw key is never included.

RETURNS: { id, keyPrefix, description, role, delegateAllTokens, tokenNames, expiresAt, lastUsedAt, createdAt, updatedAt }

Authentication: Requires JWT auth (call sdk.login() first).

tools.name: gala_update_api_key
tools.description:
Update an API key's metadata and permissions.

Cannot change the key itself, only metadata and permissions.
At least one field must be provided.

**Updatable fields:**
- role: Change permission level
- description: Update label/description
- delegateAllTokens: Toggle all-token access
- tokenNames: Update specific token delegations (replaces existing)
- expiresAt: Update expiration (null to remove)

RETURNS: { id, keyPrefix, description, role, delegateAllTokens, tokenNames, expiresAt, lastUsedAt, createdAt, updatedAt }

Authentication: Requires JWT auth (call sdk.login() first).

role.description: New role for the API key (optional)

expiresAt.description: Updated expiration date in ISO 8601 format. Pass null to remove expiration (optional).

tools.name: gala_revoke_api_key
tools.description:
Revoke an API key.

This performs a soft delete - the key becomes immediately unusable
but is retained for audit purposes.

RETURNS: { success: true, message: "API key revoked" }

Authentication: Requires JWT auth (call sdk.login() first).

tools.name: gala_get_api_key_roles
tools.description:
Get all valid API key roles.

Returns the list of available roles for API keys.
Useful for understanding the permission hierarchy.

**Roles (hierarchical):**
- MODERATOR: Manage comments, chat messages, ban/unban users
- TECHNICAL_PRODUCER: Simulcast targets, stream key, stop/start stream
- MANAGER: Moderator + Technical Producer + recordings + stream settings
- OWNER: Full access (indistinguishable from normal auth)

RETURNS: { roles: ["MODERATOR", "TECHNICAL_PRODUCER", "MANAGER", "OWNER"] }

Authentication: None required (utility method).

tools.name: gala_create_moderator_invite
tools.description:
Create a moderator invite for a token or all tokens.

Creates a magic link invite that can be shared to grant moderator access.
The recipient claims the invite after logging in.

**Invite Scopes:**
- TOKEN (default): Access to a specific token only. tokenName is required.
- ALL_OWNER_TOKENS: Blanket access to ALL tokens owned by the inviter.
  The moderator gains access to current AND future tokens. Omit tokenName.

**Roles:**
- MODERATOR: Manage comments, chat, bans
- TECHNICAL_PRODUCER: Stream control, simulcast, stream key
- MANAGER: All of the above + recordings + stream settings

**Note:** OWNER role is not available for invites.

RETURNS: { invite: { id, inviteScope, tokenName, role, inviteCode, inviteUrl, description, status, expiresAt, createdAt } }

Authentication: Requires JWT auth as token owner.

inviteScope.description:
Invite scope (default: TOKEN):
- TOKEN: Access to a specific token only (tokenName required)
- ALL_OWNER_TOKENS: Blanket access to ALL tokens owned by the inviter (tokenName should be omitted).

tokenName.description: Token name (required for TOKEN scope, omit for ALL_OWNER_TOKENS)

role.description:
Role to grant:
- MODERATOR: Manage comments, chat messages, ban/unban users
- TECHNICAL_PRODUCER: Simulcast targets, stream key, stop/start stream
- MANAGER: All of the above + recordings + stream settings.

description.description: Optional description/label for the invite (e.g., "John - Friday shows"). Max 255 characters.

expiresAt.description: Optional expiration date in ISO 8601 format (e.g., "2025-12-31T23:59:59Z"). If not provided, never expires.

tools.name: gala_claim_moderator_invite
tools.description:
Claim a moderator invite.

Claims an invite using the code from a magic link URL. The authenticated
user's wallet becomes the moderator with the granted role.

**Requirements:**
- Invite must be in PENDING status
- Invite must not be expired

**Returns based on invite scope:**
- TOKEN scope: { token: { tokenName, tokenSymbol, role, inviteScope, ... } }
- ALL_OWNER_TOKENS scope: { blanketAccess: { inviteScope, role, claimedAt } }

Authentication: Requires JWT auth.

inviteCode.description: The 64-character hex invite code from the magic link URL.

tools.name: gala_get_moderated_tokens
tools.description:
Get all tokens the current user moderates.

Returns a paginated list of tokens where the authenticated user has claimed
a moderator invite and has active access using cursor-based pagination.
Used for the /studio dashboard.

RETURNS: { tokens: [...], pageInfo: { hasNextPage, endCursor, hasPreviousPage, startCursor } }

Authentication: Requires JWT auth.

cursor.description: Cursor from previous response (omit for first page).

tools.name: gala_list_moderator_invites
tools.description:
List moderator invites.

Returns a paginated list of moderator invites using cursor-based pagination.
Behavior depends on tokenName:
- With tokenName: Returns invites for that specific token (verifies ownership)
- Without tokenName: Returns ALL invites created by the authenticated user across all tokens

RETURNS: { invites: [...], pageInfo: { hasNextPage, endCursor, hasPreviousPage, startCursor } }

Authentication: Requires JWT auth.

tokenName.description: Token name to filter by (optional - omit to list ALL invites across all tokens)

status.description:
Filter invites by status:
- PENDING: Not yet claimed
- CLAIMED: Claimed by a moderator
- REVOKED: Revoked by the owner
- EXPIRED: Past expiration date.

cursor.description: Cursor from previous response (omit for first page).

tools.name: gala_revoke_moderator_invite
tools.description:
Revoke a moderator invite.

Revokes an invite by ID, preventing it from being claimed. If already claimed,
the moderator loses access to the token.

RETURNS: { success: true, message: "Invite revoked" }

Authentication: Requires JWT auth as token owner.

tools.name: gala_update_moderator_invite_role
tools.description:
Update the role of a moderator invite.

Changes the role granted by the invite. For claimed invites, the moderator's
effective permissions change immediately (enforced at runtime).

**Roles:**
- MODERATOR: Manage comments, chat, bans
- TECHNICAL_PRODUCER: Stream control, simulcast, stream key
- MANAGER: All of the above + recordings + stream settings

**Note:** OWNER role is not available for invites.

RETURNS: { invite: { id, inviteScope, tokenName, role, inviteCode, inviteUrl, description, status, expiresAt, createdAt } }

Authentication: Requires JWT auth as token owner.

role.description:
Role to grant:
- MODERATOR: Manage comments, chat messages, ban/unban users
- TECHNICAL_PRODUCER: Simulcast targets, stream key, stop/start stream
- MANAGER: All of the above + recordings + stream settings.

tools.name: gala_update_moderator_invite
tools.description:
Update a moderator invite's role and/or description.

Updates an existing moderator invite. At least one of role or description must be provided.
Can update role, description, or both in a single call.

**Roles:**
- MODERATOR: Manage comments, chat, bans
- TECHNICAL_PRODUCER: Stream control, simulcast, stream key
- MANAGER: All of the above + recordings + stream settings

RETURNS: { invite: { id, inviteScope, tokenName, role, inviteCode, inviteUrl, description, status, expiresAt, createdAt } }

Authentication: Requires JWT auth as token owner.

description.description: Updated description/label for the invite (optional). Max 255 characters.

tools.name: gala_get_moderator_invite
tools.description:
Get invite details by code (public endpoint).

Returns public information about an invite for the claim page. This is used
by the frontend to display invite details before the user logs in to claim.

**Returned info:**
- Token name, symbol, image
- Role to be granted
- Invite status and expiration
- Who created the invite

RETURNS: { tokenName, tokenSymbol, tokenImage, role, description, status, expiresAt, invitedBy: { address, fullName } }

Authentication: None required (public endpoint).

inviteCode.description: The 64-character hex invite code from the magic link URL.

tools.name: gala_on_moderator_changed
tools.description:
Watch for moderator management events in real-time.

Triggers when moderators are added, removed, or their roles are updated. Includes:
- MODERATOR_ADDED: New moderator invitation accepted
- MODERATOR_REMOVED: Moderator permissions revoked
- MODERATOR_ROLE_UPDATED: Permission level changed (e.g., to MANAGER)

Returns:
- moderatorsChanged: Number of moderator change events detected
- events: Array of moderator events with tokenName, moderatorAddress, eventType, and role information

Filter Options:
- tokenName: REQUIRED. Moderator changes are watched per-token; there is no way to watch every token at once.
- eventType: Filter by event type ('ADDED', 'REMOVED', or 'ROLE_UPDATED')
- moderatorAddress: Only watch changes for a specific moderator.

moderatorAddress.description: Only watch changes for this moderator (optional).

durationSeconds.description: How long to watch for new events in seconds (default: 60).

tools.name: gala_get_active_moderators
tools.description:
Get the roster of active (already-accepted) moderators for a specific token.

There is no dedicated moderator-roster endpoint - a moderator's invite record IS their
moderator record, so this lists invites for the token with status 'CLAIMED' (accepted).
A PENDING invite has not been accepted yet and is not included; use
gala_list_moderator_invites to see pending/revoked/expired invites too.

Returns: Array of { address, role, joinedAt, inviteId } - role is the ModeratorRole enum
value (MODERATOR, TECHNICAL_PRODUCER, MANAGER, OWNER). There is no separate permissions
breakdown; permissions are implied by role.

tokenName.description: The token name to get the moderator roster for.

tools.name: gala_create_flag
tools.description:
Create a content flag/report.

Two-tier system:
- Chat/Comment: reason and details are optional (one-click flag)
- Stream: reason is REQUIRED (modal flow)

Use this when a user reports inappropriate content.

RETURNS: { flag: { id, tokenName, contentType, contentId, reporterAddress, reportedUserAddress, reason, details, status, createdAt } }

Authentication: Requires JWT auth (logged-in user session).

contentType.description:
Type of content being flagged:
- CHAT_MESSAGE: A chat message in the stream
- COMMENT: A comment on the token page
- STREAM: The live stream itself

contentId.description: ID of the content being flagged (message ID, comment ID, or stream ID).

reportedUserAddress.description: Wallet address of the user who created the flagged content.

reason.description:
Reason for the flag (required for STREAM, optional for others):
- INAPPROPRIATE_CONTENT: Explicit, offensive, or unsuitable content
- SPAM: Unsolicited promotional or repetitive content
- HARASSMENT: Bullying, threats, or targeted attacks
- SCAM: Fraudulent or deceptive content
- OTHER: Other reason (specify in details)

details.description: Additional details about the flag (optional, max 500 characters).

tools.name: gala_list_flags
tools.description:
List flags for a specific token with pagination and filtering.

Authorization varies by content type:
- CHAT_MESSAGE/COMMENT: Token owner or moderator (JWT) can view
- STREAM: Admin API key only

Use to review pending flags for a specific token.
For global flags across all tokens, use gala_list_global_flags.

Each flag includes an optional `aiModeration` field with AI analysis results:
- status: PENDING | PROCESSING | COMPLETED | FAILED
- recommendation: NO_ACTION | REVIEW_REQUIRED | DELETE_CONTENT | BAN_USER | DELETE_AND_BAN
- confidence: 0.0-1.0
- summary, categories, reasoning

RETURNS: { flags: [{ ..., aiModeration?: { status, recommendation, confidence, summary, categories, reasoning, provider, completedAt, errorMessage } }], pageInfo: { hasNextPage, endCursor } }

Authentication: Requires streamAdminApiKey (admin) OR JWT auth (token owner/moderator).

status.description:
Filter by flag status:
- PENDING: Not yet reviewed
- DISMISSED: Reviewed, no action taken
- ACTIONED: Reviewed, action was taken

cursor.description: Cursor from previous response (omit for first page).

tools.name: gala_list_global_flags
tools.description:
List ALL flags globally across all tokens with pagination and filtering.

For overseers and admins to view flags across the entire platform.
Use listFlags() for token-specific flag lists.

Filter options:
- tokenName: Filter to a specific token
- contentType: Filter by CHAT_MESSAGE, COMMENT, or STREAM
- status: Filter by PENDING, DISMISSED, or ACTIONED
- reason: Filter by flag reason (SPAM, HARASSMENT, etc.)
- reporterAddress: Filter by who submitted the flag
- reportedUserAddress: Filter by the content author

Each flag includes an optional `aiModeration` field with AI analysis results when AI moderation is enabled.

RETURNS: { flags: [{ ..., aiModeration?: { status, recommendation, confidence, summary, categories, reasoning, provider } }], pageInfo: { hasNextPage, endCursor } }

Authentication: Requires streamAdminApiKey (admin) OR JWT auth (overseer).

tokenName.description: Filter by token name (optional - omit to show all tokens)

status.description:
Filter by flag status:
- PENDING: Not yet reviewed
- DISMISSED: Reviewed, no action taken
- ACTIONED: Reviewed, action was taken

cursor.description: Cursor from previous response (omit for first page).

tools.name: gala_dismiss_flag
tools.description:
Dismiss a flag (no action taken).

Marks the flag as reviewed but takes no action on the content.
Use when the flag is invalid, unfounded, or doesn't warrant action.

RETURNS: { flag: { id, status: 'DISMISSED', reviewedBy, reviewedAt, ... } }

Authentication: Requires streamAdminApiKey (admin) OR JWT auth (token owner/moderator).

tools.name: gala_action_flag
tools.description:
Take action on a flag.

Actions available:
- DELETE_CONTENT: Remove the flagged content
- BAN_USER: Ban the reported user from the token
- DELETE_AND_BAN: Both delete content and ban user

Use when the flag is valid and requires action.

RETURNS: { flag: { id, status: 'ACTIONED', actionTaken, reviewedBy, reviewedAt, ... } }

Authentication: Requires streamAdminApiKey (admin) OR JWT auth (token owner/moderator).

action.description:
Action to take on the flagged content:
- DELETE_CONTENT: Remove the flagged content only
- BAN_USER: Ban the reported user from the token
- DELETE_AND_BAN: Delete content AND ban user

tools.name: gala_create_overseer_invite
tools.description:
Create an overseer invite.

Overseers have GLOBAL platform access with MANAGER-level permissions across ALL tokens
(current and future). This is different from moderators who have token-scoped access.

Creates a magic link invite that can be shared to grant overseer access.
The recipient claims the invite after logging in.

RETURNS: { invite: { id, inviteCode, inviteUrl, invitedBy, claimedBy, description, status, expiresAt, createdAt } }

Authentication: Requires streamAdminApiKey (admin) OR JWT auth as existing Overseer.

description.description: Optional description/label for the invite (e.g., "John - Platform Team"). Max 255 characters.

expiresAt.description: Optional expiration date in ISO 8601 format (e.g., "2025-12-31T23:59:59Z"). If not provided, never expires.

tools.name: gala_list_overseer_invites
tools.description:
List all overseer invites with cursor-based pagination and filtering.

Returns a paginated list of overseer invites that can be filtered by status.

RETURNS: { invites: [...], pageInfo: { hasNextPage, endCursor, hasPreviousPage, startCursor } }

Authentication: Requires streamAdminApiKey (admin) OR JWT auth as existing Overseer.

status.description:
Filter invites by status:
- PENDING: Not yet claimed
- CLAIMED: Claimed by an overseer
- REVOKED: Revoked by admin/overseer
- EXPIRED: Past expiration date.

cursor.description: Cursor from previous response (omit for first page).

tools.name: gala_get_overseer_invite
tools.description:
Get overseer invite details by code (public endpoint).

Returns public information about an invite for the claim page. This is used
by the frontend to display invite details before the user logs in to claim.

**Returned info:**
- Description (if set)
- Invite status and expiration
- Who created the invite

RETURNS: { description, status, expiresAt, invitedBy: { address, fullName } }

Authentication: None required (public endpoint).

inviteCode.description: The invite code from the magic link URL.

tools.name: gala_claim_overseer_invite
tools.description:
Claim an overseer invite.

Claims an invite using the code from a magic link URL. The authenticated
user's wallet becomes an overseer with GLOBAL access to ALL tokens on the platform.

**Requirements:**
- Invite must be in PENDING status
- Invite must not be expired

RETURNS: { invite: { id, inviteCode, inviteUrl, invitedBy, claimedBy, description, status, expiresAt, claimedAt, createdAt } }

Authentication: Requires JWT auth.

inviteCode.description: The invite code from the magic link URL.

tools.name: gala_revoke_overseer_invite
tools.description:
Revoke an overseer invite.

Revokes an invite by ID, preventing it from being claimed. If already claimed,
the overseer loses access to the platform.

RETURNS: { success: true, message: "Invite revoked" }

Authentication: Requires streamAdminApiKey (admin) OR JWT auth as existing Overseer.

tools.name: gala_list_overseers
tools.description:
List all overseers with cursor-based pagination and filtering.

Returns a paginated list of overseers that can be filtered by status.

RETURNS: { overseers: [...], pageInfo: { hasNextPage, endCursor, hasPreviousPage, startCursor } }

Authentication: Requires streamAdminApiKey (admin) OR JWT auth as existing Overseer.

status.description:
Filter overseers by status:
- ACTIVE: Currently active overseer
- REVOKED: Access has been revoked.

cursor.description: Cursor from previous response (omit for first page).

tools.name: gala_create_overseer_direct
tools.description:
Create an overseer directly (bypassing invite flow).

Directly promotes a user to overseer status without requiring them to claim an invite.
A synthetic invite record is created for audit trail.

Use this when you need to promote someone programmatically without requiring their
interaction (e.g., CLI admin tools, automated tests).

RETURNS: { overseer: { id, userAddress, inviteId, status, createdAt } }

Authentication: Requires streamAdminApiKey (admin) OR JWT auth as existing Overseer.

userAddress.description: Wallet address to promote to overseer (eth|... or 0x... format).

description.description: Optional description/label for the invite (e.g., "John - Platform Team"). Max 255 characters.

tools.name: gala_revoke_overseer
tools.description:
Revoke an overseer's access.

Revokes an overseer by wallet address, removing their global platform access.

RETURNS: { success: true, message: "Overseer access revoked" }

Authentication: Requires streamAdminApiKey (admin) OR JWT auth as existing Overseer.

address.description: Wallet address of the overseer to revoke (eth|... or 0x... format).

tools.name: gala_get_my_overseer_status
tools.description:
Check your own overseer status.

Returns whether the authenticated user is currently an active overseer
and their details if so.

RETURNS: { isOverseer: boolean, overseer?: { id, userAddress, inviteId, status, createdAt } }

Authentication: Requires JWT auth.

tools.name: gala_get_overseer_summary
tools.description:
Get platform summary for CCTV dashboard.

Returns quick counts for the overseer monitoring dashboard:
- Active streams (pools with live streams)
- Total viewers across all active streams
- Pending content flags awaiting review
- Total pools on the platform
- Graduated pools (the pools gala_fetch_pools lists with isGraduated=true)

Use this for dashboard header stats. For detailed data, use:
- gala_fetch_pools (filter by muxStreamStatus=ACTIVE) for stream list
- gala_get_global_flags (status=PENDING) for pending flags

RETURNS: { activeStreams, totalViewers, pendingFlags, totalPools, graduatedPools }

Authentication: Requires streamAdminApiKey (admin) OR JWT auth as Overseer.

tools.name: gala_get_ban_stats
tools.description:
Get global user ban statistics.

Returns the total count of active global user bans on the platform.

RETURNS: { total: number }

Authentication: Requires streamAdminApiKey (admin) OR JWT auth as Overseer.

tools.name: gala_get_token_ban_stats
tools.description:
Get token ban (delisted tokens) statistics.

Returns the total count of delisted/banned tokens on the platform.

RETURNS: { total: number }

Authentication: Requires streamAdminApiKey (admin) OR JWT auth as Overseer.

tools.name: gala_get_invite_stats
tools.description:
Get overseer invite statistics.

Returns counts for each invite status: total, pending, claimed, and revoked.

RETURNS: { total: number, pending: number, claimed: number, revoked: number }

Authentication: Requires streamAdminApiKey (admin) OR JWT auth as Overseer.

tools.name: gala_get_flag_stats
tools.description:
Get content flag statistics.

Returns counts for each flag status: total, pending, actioned, and dismissed.

RETURNS: { total: number, pending: number, actioned: number, dismissed: number }

Authentication: Requires streamAdminApiKey (admin) OR JWT auth as Overseer.

tools.name: gala_get_user_stats
tools.description:
Get user management statistics.

Returns counts for total users, flagged users (with pending content flags), and banned users (with active global bans).

RETURNS: { totalUsers: number, flaggedUsers: number, bannedUsers: number }

Authentication: Requires streamAdminApiKey (admin) OR JWT auth as Overseer.

tools.name: gala_list_overseer_users
tools.description:
List users with pagination and sorting (Overseer/Admin only).

Retrieves a paginated list of users across the platform with optional filtering and sorting.
Useful for overseer/admin dashboard user management.

**Sort Options:**
- address: User wallet address
- flagsReceived: Content flags received
- activeBans: Active bans count
- createdAt: Account creation date (default)

RETURNS: { items: [...], total: number, cursor?, pageSize }

Authentication: Requires streamAdminApiKey (admin) OR JWT auth as existing Overseer.

search.description: Search by user address or name.

cursor.description: Cursor from previous response for pagination (omit for first page).

tools.name: gala_get_overseer_user_summary
tools.description:
Get comprehensive user summary (Admin/Overseer only).

Retrieves full profile, activity metrics, ban status, and other detailed information
for a specific user. Perfect for overseer dashboard user detail pages.

RETURNS: { address, profile: { name, image, bio }, statistics: { tokens, positions, trades }, metrics: { flagsReceived, activeBans }, createdAt }

Authentication: Requires streamAdminApiKey (admin) OR JWT auth as existing Overseer.

userAddress.description: User wallet address to get summary for.

tools.name: gala_flush_cache_by_address
tools.description:
Flush all cache entries for a wallet address.

Clears all cached data associated with the specified address including:
- User profile data (profile:data:*, profile:stats:*)
- Overseer status
- Owned tokens list
- Ban status (global and per-token)
- Moderator access entries

Use this when:
- User data appears stale or incorrect
- After debugging user-specific issues
- Resolving profile display inconsistencies

RETURNS: { flushedCount, duration, target }
- flushedCount: Number of cache keys flushed
- duration: Time taken in milliseconds
- target: Normalized address that was flushed

Authentication: Requires streamAdminApiKey (admin) OR JWT auth as existing Overseer.

address.description: Wallet address to flush cache for (eth|... or 0x... format).

tools.name: gala_flush_cache_by_token
tools.description:
Flush all cache entries for a token.

Clears all cached data associated with the specified token including:
- Stream chat messages and pinned messages
- Recordings list
- Holders data and rankings
- Token ban status
- Price data (GALA and USD)
- Vault address mapping

Use this when:
- Token data appears stale or incorrect
- Chat/stream data seems outdated
- Price or holder data is inconsistent
- After modifying token settings

RETURNS: { flushedCount, duration, target }
- flushedCount: Number of cache keys flushed
- duration: Time taken in milliseconds
- target: Normalized token name that was flushed

Authentication: Requires streamAdminApiKey (admin) OR JWT auth as existing Overseer.

tokenName.description: Token name to flush cache for (case-insensitive).

tools.name: gala_flush_all_cache
tools.description:
⚠️ NUCLEAR OPTION: Flush ALL Launchpad cache.

Clears ALL cached data across the entire Launchpad platform. This includes:
- All user profile data
- All token data (chat, recordings, holders, prices)
- All overseer/moderator access data
- All ban status data
- Site configuration cache
- Everything else

**WARNING:** This will cause a temporary performance hit as all data
needs to be re-fetched from the database. Use only when absolutely necessary.

**Safety Feature:** Requires confirm=true to prevent accidental usage.

Use this when:
- Major cache corruption suspected
- After database migrations
- Debugging platform-wide issues
- Testing cache behavior

RETURNS: { flushedCount, duration }
- flushedCount: Total number of cache keys flushed
- duration: Time taken in milliseconds

Authentication: Requires streamAdminApiKey (admin) OR JWT auth as existing Overseer.

confirm.description: Safety confirmation flag - MUST be true to proceed with flush all cache. This is the nuclear option!

tools.name: gala_flush_cache_wallet_aliases
tools.description:
Flush wallet-alias cache entries (eth| → client| resolution cache).

Clears the Redis cache that maps eth| addresses to their GalaChain client| aliases.
Use this when a user's login returns a stale eth| address even though they have
a client| alias on GalaChain. After flushing, the next login will re-resolve
the alias from the GalaChain public-key contract.

- Without address: flushes ALL wallet-alias entries (use after updating the public-key contract URL)
- With address: flushes only the specified address's alias entry

Use this when:
- A user logs in and gets their eth| address instead of their client| alias
- After fixing GALA_PUBLIC_KEY_CONTRACT configuration
- After a GalaChain network outage caused null-cached aliases
- Debugging alias resolution issues on dev/staging environments

RETURNS: { flushedCount, duration, target? }
- flushedCount: Number of alias cache entries flushed
- duration: Time taken in milliseconds
- target: Normalized address (only present when flushing a single address)

Authentication: Requires streamAdminApiKey (admin) OR JWT auth as existing Overseer.

address.description: Optional wallet address (eth|... or 0x... format). If omitted, ALL wallet-alias entries are flushed.

tools.name: gala_ban_token
tools.description:
Ban a token from the platform (overseer only).

When a token is banned:
- Hidden from ALL pool listings (including creator's profile)
- Comments blocked on banned tokens
- Live streaming blocked on banned tokens
- Chat messages blocked on banned tokens
- Trading NOT blocked (GalaChain handles trading independently)

Token bans are permanent until explicitly removed by an overseer.

RETURNS: { ban: { id, tokenName, reason, bannedBy, createdAt, updatedAt }, tokenName }

Authentication: Requires streamAdminApiKey (admin) OR JWT auth with overseer status.

reason.description: Ban reason (optional, max 500 characters). E.g., "Fraudulent project", "Scam token", etc.

tools.name: gala_unban_token
tools.description:
Remove a ban from a token (overseer only).

When a token is unbanned:
- Restored to all pool listings
- Visible on creator's profile again
- Comments re-enabled
- Live streaming re-enabled
- Chat re-enabled

RETURNS: { removed: true, tokenName }

Authentication: Requires streamAdminApiKey (admin) OR JWT auth with overseer status.

tools.name: gala_list_token_bans
tools.description:
List all banned tokens (overseer only).

Returns a paginated list of all banned tokens with their ban details using cursor-based pagination.
Supports searching by token name (partial match).

RETURNS: { items: [{ id, tokenName, reason, bannedBy, createdAt, updatedAt }...], pageInfo: { hasNextPage, endCursor, hasPreviousPage, startCursor } }

Authentication: Requires streamAdminApiKey (admin) OR JWT auth with overseer status.

cursor.description: Cursor from previous response (omit for first page).

search.description: Search by token name (partial match, case-insensitive).

tools.name: gala_get_token_ban
tools.description:
Get ban details for a specific token (overseer only).

Returns whether the token is banned and ban details if applicable.
Use this for detailed ban information including reason and who banned it.

RETURNS: { banned: boolean, ban?: { id, tokenName, reason, bannedBy, createdAt, updatedAt }, tokenName }

Authentication: Requires streamAdminApiKey (admin) OR JWT auth with overseer status.

tools.name: gala_is_token_banned
tools.description:
Check if a token is banned (overseer only).

Convenience alias for getTokenBan - provided for semantic clarity.
Use when you just need to check if a token is banned.

RETURNS: { banned: boolean, ban?: { id, tokenName, reason, bannedBy, createdAt, updatedAt }, tokenName }

Authentication: Requires streamAdminApiKey (admin) OR JWT auth with overseer status.

tools.name: gala_on_token_ban_changed
tools.description:
Watch for token ban and unban events in real-time.

Triggers when tokens are banned or unbanned by administrators. Includes:
- TOKEN_BANNED: Token removed from trading/creation due to policy violation
- TOKEN_UNBANNED: Ban lifted, token restored to normal status

Returns:
- tokenBansChanged: Number of ban status change events detected
- events: Array of ban events with tokenName, newBanStatus, reason, and timestamp

Filter Options:
- tokenName: REQUIRED. Token bans are watched per-token; there is no way to watch every token at once.
- banStatus: Filter by status ('BANNED' or 'UNBANNED').

tokenName.description: Watch ban changes for this token (required).

durationSeconds.description: How long to watch for new events in seconds (default: 60).

tools.name: gala_fetch_messages
tools.description:
Query messages with type/tokenName/userAddress filters.

Returns paginated list of messages using cursor-based pagination.
At least one of type, tokenName, or userAddress must be provided.
Public endpoint - no authentication required.

**Filter Combinations:**
- type=CHAT + tokenName → Chat messages for a token
- type=COMMENT + tokenName → Comments for a token
- userAddress → All messages from a user
- type + userAddress → User's messages of a specific type

**Message Fields:**
- id: Unique message ID (for updates/deletes/reactions)
- type: CHAT or COMMENT
- tokenName, tokenImage: Pool information
- userAddress, userProfile: Author information
- content: Message text
- createdAt, updatedAt: Timestamps
- reactions: Reaction counts by emoji type
- flagCount: Number of flags against this message
- holderTier?: Token holder tier badge ({ tier: 0-5, tierName: string })
- isPinned?: Whether this message is pinned (CHAT only)

RETURNS: {
  messages: [...],
  pageInfo: { hasNextPage, endCursor, hasPreviousPage, startCursor }
}

Authentication: None required (public endpoint)

type.description: Message type filter (CHAT for chat messages, COMMENT for comments).

userAddress.description: User address to filter by (eth|... or 0x... format).

search.description: Full-text search on message content (case-insensitive partial match).

cursor.description: Cursor from previous response (omit for first page).

tools.name: gala_create_message
tools.description:
Create a new message on a token pool.

Posts a message to the specified token as either a CHAT message or COMMENT.
Messages are stored in the unified pool_messages table.

**Content Limits:**
- CHAT: 1-500 characters
- COMMENT: 1-2000 characters

RETURNS: {
  message: {
    id, type, tokenName, tokenImage, userAddress, userProfile,
    content, createdAt, deletedAt, flagCount, reactions, holderTier?
  }
}

holderTier is present if the author holds tokens ({ tier: 0-5, tierName: string }).

Use the returned id with gala_update_message or gala_delete_message.

Authentication: Requires JWT session (call gala_login first)

type.description: Message type (CHAT for chat messages, COMMENT for comments).

tokenName.description: Token name to post the message to (e.g., "anime").

content.description: Message content (1-500 chars for CHAT, 1-2000 chars for COMMENT).

tools.name: gala_update_message

id.description: Message ID in format msg-{timestamp}-{uuid} or chat-{timestamp}-{uuid} (supports both modern and legacy formats).

tools.name: gala_delete_message
tools.description:
Delete a message.

Soft-deletes a message (CHAT or COMMENT) from the pool.

**Authorization:**
- Message author (JWT auth)
- Pool owner (JWT auth)
- Moderator with MANAGE_CHAT/MANAGE_COMMENTS permission (API key auth)
- Platform overseer

The message remains in the database with deletedAt set (soft delete).

RETURNS: { success: true }

Authentication: Requires JWT session OR API key with MANAGE_CHAT or MANAGE_COMMENTS permission.

id.description: Message ID in format msg-{timestamp}-{uuid} or chat-{timestamp}-{uuid} (supports both modern and legacy formats).

tools.name: gala_get_pinned_message
gala_pin_message
tools.description:
Pin a message to a token's chat.

Only one message can be pinned per token at a time.
Pinning a new message automatically unpins any previously pinned message.

**Authorization:**
- Token owner (JWT auth)
- Moderator with MANAGER or MODERATOR role (JWT or API key)

RETURNS: { success: true }

Authentication: Requires streamAdminApiKey (admin) OR JWT auth (token owner)

id.description: ID of the message to pin.

tools.name: gala_unpin_message
tools.description:
Unpin a message from a token's chat.

Removes the pinned status from a message.

**Authorization:**
- Token owner (JWT auth)
- Moderator with MANAGER or MODERATOR role (JWT or API key)

RETURNS: { success: true }

Authentication: Requires streamAdminApiKey (admin) OR JWT auth (token owner)

id.description: ID of the message to unpin.

tools.name: gala_get_message_stats
tools.description:
Get platform-wide message statistics.

Returns aggregated metrics across all messages on the platform:
- Total message count
- Messages created today
- Unique user authors
- Unique tokens with messages
- Breakdown by message type (CHAT vs COMMENT)

RETURNS: {
  stats: {
    totalMessages: number,
    todayMessages: number,
    uniqueUsers: number,
    uniqueTokens: number,
    messagesByType: { CHAT: number, COMMENT: number }
  }
}

Authentication: Requires streamAdminApiKey (admin) OR JWT auth (overseer).

tools.name: gala_get_restricted_names
gala_update_restricted_names
tools.description:
Update the restricted token names content.

Replaces the entire list with newline-separated words.
Newlines separate individual words to restrict.

**Authorization:** Overseer only (JWT)

RETURNS: { success: true }

tools.name: gala_add_content_reaction
tools.description:
Add a reaction to a pool message (chat or comment).

Requires JWT or API key authentication.
Adding the same reaction type again is a no-op (idempotent).
Users can have multiple different reaction types on the same message.

RETURNS: { data: { reactions, totalCount }, created: boolean }

Authentication: Requires JWT session (call sdk.login() first).

messageId.description: Message ID in format msg-{timestamp}-{uuid} or chat-{timestamp}-{uuid} (supports both modern and legacy formats).

reactionType.description: Type of reaction: heart, fire, laugh, wow, or thumbs_up.

tools.name: gala_remove_content_reaction
tools.description:
Remove a reaction from a pool message.

Requires JWT or API key authentication.
Only the user who created the reaction can remove it.

RETURNS: { success: true }

Authentication: Requires JWT session (call sdk.login() first).

messageId.description: Message ID in format msg-{timestamp}-{uuid} or chat-{timestamp}-{uuid} (supports both modern and legacy formats).

reactionType.description: Type of reaction: heart, fire, laugh, wow, or thumbs_up.

tools.name: gala_add_reaction_to_chat_message
tools.description:
Add a reaction to a chat message.

Convenience wrapper for addContentReaction specifically for chat messages.

RETURNS: { data: { reactions, totalCount }, created: boolean }

Authentication: Requires JWT session (call sdk.login() first).

messageId.description: Message ID in format msg-{timestamp}-{uuid} or chat-{timestamp}-{uuid} (supports both modern and legacy formats).

reactionType.description: Type of reaction: heart, fire, laugh, wow, or thumbs_up.

tools.name: gala_remove_reaction_from_chat_message
tools.description:
Remove a reaction from a chat message.

Convenience wrapper for removeContentReaction specifically for chat messages.

RETURNS: { success: true }

Authentication: Requires JWT session (call sdk.login() first).

messageId.description: Message ID in format msg-{timestamp}-{uuid} or chat-{timestamp}-{uuid} (supports both modern and legacy formats).

tools.name: gala_global_feed_reference
tools.description:
Reference: Subscribe to the global feed for real-time updates.

**IMPORTANT**: The global feed is a CLIENT-SIDE feature that requires the SDK to be initialized with WebSocket support.
This tool provides documentation. Actual subscription happens in your client code.

## Global Feed Overview

The global feed broadcasts all important platform events to all subscribed clients:

### Token Events (real-time for all tokens):
- **stream_status**: Stream active/idle/disabled changes
- **trade_executed**: Buy/sell trades on bonding curves
- **holder_count_updated**: Holder count changes
- **pool_badge_assigned**: Token badge assignments
- **viewer_count**: Live viewer count updates

### Site Config Events (platform-wide):
- **site_config_changed**: Generic config changes
- **stream_global_status**: Global streaming enabled/disabled
- **chat_global_status**: Global chat enabled/disabled
- **comments_global_status**: Global comments enabled/disabled
- **webhooks_global_status**: Global webhooks enabled/disabled

## Usage in Client Code

launchpad-sdk's StreamWebSocketService subscribes to the feed (the SDK ships no React hooks for it:
in React, keep the service in your component state and unsubscribe on unmount).

```typescript
import { StreamWebSocketService, getEnvironmentConfig } from '@gala-chain/launchpad-sdk';

const service = new StreamWebSocketService({
  url: getEnvironmentConfig('prod').launchpadBaseUrl,
});

// Registers the callbacks, opens the socket, joins the feed once connected. Any number of
// subscriptions share one feed room; the returned function removes only this one.
const unsubscribe = service.subscribeToGlobalFeed({
  onTradeExecuted: (event) => console.log('Trade:', event),
  onStreamGlobalStatus: (event) => console.log('Stream status:', event)
});
```

## Documentation

In the launchpad-sdk source tree (not in the npm package):
- Quick Start (5 min): docs/websocket/QUICKSTART.md
- Complete Guide: docs/websocket/GLOBAL-FEED.md
- Authentication: docs/websocket/AUTHENTICATION.md
- Example: examples/global-feed-demo.ts

Authentication: None required (public endpoint)

gala_global_feed_status_reference
tools.description:
Reference: Check global feed subscription status.

**IMPORTANT**: The global feed is a CLIENT-SIDE feature in the SDK.
This tool provides documentation. Status checking happens in your client code.

## Checking Subscription Status

launchpad-sdk's StreamWebSocketService holds the feed connection (the SDK ships no React hooks for
it: in React, keep the service in your component state).

```typescript
import { StreamWebSocketService, getEnvironmentConfig } from '@gala-chain/launchpad-sdk';

const service = new StreamWebSocketService({
  url: getEnvironmentConfig('prod').launchpadBaseUrl,
});

const unsubscribe = service.subscribeToGlobalFeed();
const isSubscribed = service.isSubscribedToGlobalFeed();
const isConnected = service.isConnected();

console.log(`Subscription status: ${isSubscribed ? 'subscribed' : 'not subscribed'}`);
console.log(`Connection status: ${isConnected ? 'connected' : 'disconnected'}`);
```

## Status Indicators

- **isSubscribed**: true while at least one subscriber holds the `global:feed` room
- **isConnected**: true if WebSocket connection is active and authenticated

## Common Status Scenarios

| Subscribed | Connected | Meaning |
|-----------|-----------|---------|
| false | false | Not initialized - subscribeToGlobalFeed() registers and opens the socket |
| true | false | Subscribed but connection dropped - reconnecting automatically, the feed is joined again on reconnect |
| false | true | Connected but no subscriber holds the feed - call subscribeToGlobalFeed() |
| true | true | ✅ Ready to receive events |

## Documentation

In the launchpad-sdk source tree (not in the npm package):
- Quick Start (5 min): docs/websocket/QUICKSTART.md
- Complete Guide: docs/websocket/GLOBAL-FEED.md
- Example: examples/global-feed-demo.ts

Authentication: None required (public endpoint)
